authorization.quote: Audit the whole site to ensure the new design system is applied everywhere - color, typography, etc.
authorization.scope: Audit and correct application of the already approved Ink & Voice design; no new visual direction or publication.

reviewer: Current chat assistant; Samanta implementation / Drishti self-review

findings_fixed.title: Share dialog carried the historical logo
findings_fixed.before: The dynamically created share card used the old teal symbol asset.
findings_fixed.after: It now uses the current theme-aware mulberry leaf mark and aqua water drop, with the current SVG as fallback.

findings_fixed.title: Shared overlays retained blue-green shading
findings_fixed.before: Dialog and menu backdrops retained an old teal scrim; page-turn shadow also retained a teal tint.
findings_fixed.after: Backdrops use the charcoal Ink & Voice scrim; the fold shadow uses the existing theme shadow token.

findings_fixed.title: Search redirect fallback lacked the shared theme
findings_fixed.before: The redirect’s visible fallback did not load the complete design system.
findings_fixed.after: The fallback has the shared palette, fonts, spacing, saved/system theme and current favicon. Search still preserves the query when redirecting to Poems.

findings_fixed.title: English quotations inherited an editorial’s script font
findings_fixed.before: An English source quotation within a Hindi or Odia editorial inherited the surrounding script family.
findings_fixed.after: English quotation blocks explicitly use Literata, while Hindi and Odia quotations keep their own script families.

findings_fixed.title: Text enlargement broke the masthead and badge spacing
findings_fixed.before: At a 200% root text size, the masthead could split Kabita within the word and the Original badge could overlap a neighbouring language control.
findings_fixed.after: The masthead wraps at word boundaries; controls may add rows when necessary, and the Original target grows with enlarged text. Normal-size compact layouts are retained.

findings_fixed.title: Quiet-reader Original badge inherited the poem language
findings_fixed.before: The quiet reader’s English badge inherited the original Hindi/Odia script language and font.
findings_fixed.after: An explicit English language attribute keeps the small uppercase badge in the interface font; the source-language glyph retains its own script font.

exceptions: Historical edition-cover composition, Cormorant cover typography and artwork colours intentionally retained.
Original poetry, translations, credits, portraits, font assets, runtime configuration and release/consent safeguards preserved.
Old literal colours in historical or overridden CSS are not evidence of rendered drift; no blanket substitution applied.
limitations: Whole-site inspection is automated computed-style/overflow coverage; detailed visual and interaction review samples representative page families.
200% text check temporarily enlarged the root font in the local browser; it is not a native browser-zoom or full accessibility certification.
Local Chromium/IAB review only; Safari, Firefox and native mobile apps were not separately tested.
Runtime service submissions and public Likes/comments were not sent during this design audit. Existing edition-check editorial gaps remain unchanged.
Not an independent review. No push or publication performed.
